card.name: Final part of proper names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a multi-part proper name or drug name, such as Circuit after Ninth, one after hydrocod, or ine after hydroxyz. It also fires on place and institution names like Black Rock or Hong Kong University.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a drug name split into parts, especially hydrocodone and hydroxyzine.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE The most common manifestation of hydroxyz<<ine>> overdosage is hypersedation.

modes.label: Place and institution names
modes.description: The last word of a named court, landmark, university or street.
